title: MCT ledger event
description: Append-only, hash-chained event recording one state transition. Design ref: §14. No prompt or secret bodies appear here — only object IDs, digests, sizes, decision codes, timing (§18.3).

type.description: Transition kind, e.g. 'turn.ingested', 'context.built', 'pull.fulfilled', 'response.rendered', 'epoch.changed'. Extensible; not enumerated here to avoid coupling the ledger to a frozen message list.

actor.description: Component that produced the event, e.g. 'B.gateway', 'B.pull-broker', 'A.adapter'.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; replays are folded, not re-applied (§14.2, §15.2).

previous_event_sha256.description: Hash of the previous event for tamper-evident chaining (§14.2).
